assoc.hide_on_domain: Hide me on the firm's own domain
assoc.invite_hint: The advocate must accept. Their acceptance is their consent to be listed.
assoc.no_firms: You are not listed in any firm.
assoc.no_slots: No free lawyer slots on your plan.
assoc.request_hint: The firm owner approves. You can be in up to 5 firms and can leave at any time.

contact_number.consent: I agree to AdvocateID showing this number to visitors so they can contact me. I can change or remove it at any time.
contact_number.current: Current number: {mobile}. Visitors use it for WhatsApp and calls.
contact_number.title: Connect number
domain.active: Your page is live on this domain. advocateid.in/{slug} still works inside AdvocateID and is hidden from search engines.
domain.hint: Use a name such as www.example.com. For a bare domain, your registrar must support CNAME flattening.
domain.lapsed: The domain stopped pointing to AdvocateID. Your page keeps working at advocateid.in/{slug} and is indexed there until the domain works again.
domain.locked.body: With Premium your page can run on your own domain with your own colour and no AdvocateID header.
domain.locked.title: Own domain is a Premium feature
domain.pending: The domain is saved but does not point to AdvocateID yet.
domain.step1: Add a CNAME record at your domain provider
domain.step1_body: Point your domain to this address:
domain.step2_body: DNS changes can take from a few minutes to a day. Press Check DNS when you have added the record.
editor.about_hint: Practice focus, education, memberships. No client names, ratings or promises.
editor.allow_members: Accept requests from advocates to join this firm
editor.banner_hint: Office or firm picture. No client faces and no claims in the picture.
editor.banner_locked: Banner images are available on the Professional and Premium plans.
editor.bio_hint: Plain facts: areas of practice, years, qualifications.
editor.brand_hint: Used for links, buttons and accents on your own domain. It must be dark enough to read with white text.
editor.cases_hint: Court, year, role and outcome only. No client names. Notes are plain facts.
editor.completeness: Your page is {n}% complete. Only you can see this.
editor.enrolment_hint: Shown on your page as declared by you. It is not verified.
editor.highlights_hint: A number and a label from the list.
editor.language_hint: The language you write your page in.
editor.links_hint: Professional profiles, publications or your website. Links with booking or discount wording are not allowed.
editor.name: Name
editor.photo_hint: A plain headshot. It is resized on your device before upload.
editor.show_member_of: Show the Member of list on my page
list.case_note_hint: A neutral fact in up to 200 characters.
list.case_role_hint: For example: Appeared for the petitioner.
list.highlight_hint: Format is fixed: a number up to 3 digits and a label from the list.
list.link_hint: Known sites get their own icon. Others use the site's icon.
list.plan_required: This section needs the Professional or Premium plan.
list.year_to_hint: Leave empty if it is current.
manage.nav.label: Page management
manage.title: Edit page
new.intro: Start with the required fields. You can add everything else later. An account can have up to 3 pages in total.
new.name_hint: Use your name as registered. No titles or descriptions.
new.slug_hint: 5 to 30 letters (a-z), digits or hyphens. It becomes advocateid.in/your-address.
new.slug_invalid: Use 5 to 30 letters, digits or hyphens. Some words are reserved.
new.title: Create a page
office.about_hint: Up to 200 characters. An office without a description stays out of search results.
office.name: Office name
office.phone_hint: Verified with an OTP. It is not used to log in.
offices.intro: Each office has its own page, number, focus courts and description.
plan.assigned: Plans are assigned by AdvocateID in this release. Contact us to change yours.
plan.downgrade_note: Your plan never changes where you appear in search results.
plan.f.competitors_hidden: Nearby and similar advocates are hidden on your page
plan.f.competitors_shown: Nearby and similar advocates appear on your page
plan.hidden_note: {n} items are hidden on your plan. They are kept and come back if you move to a larger plan.
posts.body_hint: Up to 10,000 characters. Educational content, no promises or outcome claims.
posts.intro: Write articles and court updates. Posts use plain facts. The wording check runs as you type and again on publish.
posts.update_hint: Up to 5,000 characters. Report facts and give the source.
slug.confirm: Change your page address? The old address will redirect for 12 months.
slug.cooldown: You can change the address again from {date}.
slug.rules: You can change it once every 90 days. The old address redirects for 12 months. A deleted address is reserved for 90 days.
